description: Source code for a streaming server component in Kubernetes, handling exec, attach, and port forwarding requests via HTTP endpoints, with support for TLS and integration with gRPC and Kubernetes CRI API.

classes.name: server
classes.description: Implementation of the Server interface, managing HTTP endpoints for streaming requests.

classes.name: criAdapter
classes.description: Adapter to conform Runtime interface to remotecommand and portforward interfaces.

methods.name: GetExec
methods.description: Generates a URL for executing commands inside a container.

methods.name: GetAttach
methods.description: Generates a URL for attaching to a container.

methods.name: GetPortForward
methods.description: Generates a URL for port forwarding.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the streaming server, listening on configured address.

methods.name: ServeHTTP
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP requests and routes to appropriate handlers.

methods.name: buildURL
methods.description: Constructs streaming URLs based on method and token.

methods.name: ExecInContainer
methods.description: Executes a command inside a container via the Runtime interface.

methods.name: AttachContainer
methods.description: Attaches to a container via the Runtime interface.

methods.name: PortForward
methods.description: Performs port forwarding via the Runtime interface.
